verdict.rationale: A connectivity platform with an admin API and policy files could plausibly offer a sandbox or test tailnet, so the axis applies. The evidence never documents a product-provided sandbox or test environment isolated from production. The closest items are adjacent: ephemeral nodes, sharing local dev servers, and a community user who separates dev, staging and prod through ACLs. These are user-side arrangements or other features, not a sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
